verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a rules API (`POST /payment/v1/rules`) that links a fiat virtual account to a blockchain address, so incoming fiat is automatically on-ramped and sent as crypto. That is a genuine event-triggered automated action, but it covers only one use case. Webhooks cover the event side but only send notifications; they do not execute actions. Missing for 10: a general-purpose rule engine with configurable triggers and conditions, rule types beyond fiat-to-crypto forwarding, a rule-management lifecycle (list, update, disable), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
